The '''Defiled Brook''' was a river that ran through the [[Nightmare Lands]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]], originating in the [[Deepest Woods]] and [[Crafted Blight]] areas before running south through the [[Sha-Thes Meadow]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Defiled Brook appears as an area on Voss in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
